# Roblox Game Design

> A handbook for designing, auditing and fixing Roblox games, built from teardowns of real hits. Every
> statement carries a time, a number or what is on screen, and every fact carries its source. AI agents
> should follow AGENTS.md.

## Start

- [Instructions for AI agents](AGENTS.md): This repository is a handbook for designing, auditing and fixing Roblox games. If you are an AI agent helping someone with a Roblox game's design, follow this file. It exists ...
- [Roblox Game Design](README.md): A field manual for designing, auditing and fixing Roblox games, built from teardowns of the games that actually hit. Written for developers and for the AI assistants they work ...
- [Writing standard](CONTRIBUTING.md): Everything in this repo follows the rules on this page. They exist because most game-design advice is true and useless: "make the core loop engaging", "reward the player", "add ...

## Foundations

- [The short version](foundations/00-the-short-version.md): The whole handbook in twenty-five lines. Each line links to the page with the evidence. Numbers are from the hits as measured in November 2026; values to aim for are marked "start ...
- [Why game designs fail](foundations/01-why-designs-fail.md): Read this once before using the rest of the handbook. It explains what the other pages are for.
- [The platform](foundations/02-the-platform.md): This page holds the facts about Roblox itself that every design has to fit: who plays and on what, how a game gets shown, which numbers are normal, who can join and talk, and what ...
- [Choosing the idea: a live reference plus one change](foundations/03-idea-and-reference.md): Open this page before you build anything, and again whenever you are about to start a second game. It covers how to pick the idea: the fantasy in one sentence, which live game to ...
- [The core loop](foundations/04-core-loop.md): Open this page when you are deciding what the player does over and over, or when players leave and you cannot say which minute bored them.
- [The first session](foundations/05-first-session.md): Open this page when you are designing what a new player does from the moment they have control, or when your dashboard shows players leaving in the first five minutes.
- [Progression and economy](foundations/06-progression-and-economy.md): Open this page when you set prices, income, upgrade costs or a rebirth, or when players stall at one purchase and leave. It gives the formulas behind buy-and-earn games, the ...
- [Rarity and collection](foundations/07-rarity-and-collection.md): Open this page when you write an odds table, set a pity counter, decide when a roll gets a cutscene or a server message, or add an index, badges or trading. It covers the odds ...
- [Retention: this session, tomorrow, weeks two to four](foundations/08-retention.md): This page answers three questions for any genre: why a player stays for the rest of this session, why they come back tomorrow, and why they are still here in weeks two to four. ...
- [Other players](foundations/09-other-players.md): This page covers server size, what players see of each other, what they can do to each other, trading, friends, and talking now that chat needs an age check. Open it when you set ...
- [Feel and feedback](foundations/10-feel-and-feedback.md): This page is about the half-second after the player does something: what they hear, what moves, what number appears, and how fast. It also covers the physics every Roblox game ...
- [Clips and packaging](foundations/11-clips-and-packaging.md): This page covers what a player meets before they control a character: title, icon, thumbnails, the game page, paid ads, creator videos and invites from friends. Open it before you ...
- [Monetization: what sells, at what price, and when to ask](foundations/12-monetization.md): This page is for pricing a Roblox game: the instruments, what the top games charge, what players buy again, and the moment an offer belongs on screen. Open it before you create ...
- [Live ops: update rhythm, events, seasons](foundations/13-live-ops.md): Open this page before launch, to plan the weeks after it, and again when the weekly numbers slide. It covers what an update contains, how often the leaders ship and on which day, ...
- [Metrics and diagnosis](foundations/14-metrics-and-diagnosis.md): Open this page after launch, when you have numbers and need to know what to change first. It lays the player's path out as one funnel with the benchmark for each step, shows how ...
- [The line: holding attention without tricking children](foundations/15-the-line.md): Other pages in this repo explain mechanics that keep players: loss, theft, random rewards, clocks, scarcity. This page says where each one stops being fair. It lists what ...

## Genres

- [Genres](genres/README.md): One playbook per genre. Every playbook has the same sections in the same order, so you can put two side by side:
- [Anime RPG and dungeon crawler](genres/anime-rpg.md): "Every quest makes me stronger, and one day I will find the fruit everyone wants."
- [Dress-up](genres/dress-up.md): "I made the best look for the theme, everyone saw it, and they gave me stars."
- [Driving, racing, and cops and robbers](genres/driving.md): "I have a garage full of cars, and I drive the fast one past everybody." In the cops-and-robbers branch: "I rob the bank and get away, or I catch the one who did."
- [Fighting and battlegrounds](genres/fighting.md): "I pick a hero, I land a combo, and everyone in the server sees me win."
- [Fishing and digging](genres/fishing-and-digging.md): "There is always one more thing in the water I have never caught, and my next rod can catch it."
- [Grow and harvest](genres/grow-and-harvest.md): "I planted it, I came back, it was huge and golden, and my friends saw it."
- [Hangout](genres/hangout.md): "I hang out, try on anything for free, talk to people, and they notice me."
- [Horror](genres/horror.md): "Something is coming. I know the sign. I got to the closet in time, and my friend did not."
- [Obby](genres/obby.md): "I got higher than last time. I made the jump everyone else falls off."
- [Party and minigames](genres/party-and-minigames.md): "Every few minutes there is a new game, and this time I might be the one who wins."
- [Pet raising and animal games](genres/pet-raising-and-animal.md): "I hatch a baby pet, look after it until it grows up, and swap pets with my friends until I have the rare glowing one."
- [Plus-one: train a stat, reach a zone, bring it home](genres/plus-one.md): "Every step makes me faster. Faster gets me farther. Farther has the good stuff, and I bring it home."
- [Puzzle, word and rhythm](genres/puzzle-word-rhythm.md): "I'm the fastest speller (or drawer, or player) in this server, and everyone just saw it."
- [RNG](genres/rng.md): "Every roll could be the one in a billion, and when it lands the whole server sees my name."
- [Roleplay and life simulation](genres/roleplay.md): "I get a house, a car and a job right away, and my friends and I play pretend in a real-looking town."
- [Sandbox, building, jobs and physics toys](genres/sandbox.md): "I built it myself, and now we find out if it works." For the job games: "I have a job, and the paycheck buys my house." For the physics toys: "I can break anything and watch it ...
- [Shooters and arena PvP](genres/shooter.md): "I beat a real person in a fair fight, and everybody in the lobby saw it."
- [Simulator](genres/simulator.md): "My pets get stronger, my number gets bigger, and every new area has a better egg."
- [Social deduction](genres/social-deduction.md): "One of us is the killer. Maybe it's me this time, and nobody knows."
- [Sports](genres/sports.md): "I rolled a rare player style and scored with it in front of nine other people."
- [Steal and defend](genres/steal-and-defend.md): "My base makes money and everyone can see it. I can take their best one, and they can take mine if I forget the lock."
- [Story](genres/story.md): "We played the whole story together, beat the boss, and next time we're getting the secret ending."
- [Survival](genres/survival.md): "Me and my friends kept the fire going one more night, and we got further than last time."
- [Tower defense](genres/tower-defense.md): "I put my towers in the right spots and nothing got through. Next time I bring a stronger one."
- [Tycoon](genres/tycoon.md): "I built this whole place myself, and it makes money while I watch."

## Teardowns

- [99 Nights in the Forest](teardowns/99-nights-in-the-forest.md): A party of 1 to 5 keeps a campfire alive for 99 in-game days while rescuing four lost kids; it set the 2025 benchmark for co-op survival runs with a 14 million player peak.
- [Teardowns](teardowns/README.md): How individual hits work, in numbers. Each follows the same template: loop,
- [Adopt Me!](teardowns/adopt-me.md): You hatch pets, raise them by filling their needs, and trade them toward rarer and glowing versions; it is the longest-running pet game at the top of Roblox.
- [Animal Hospital (Anomaly)](teardowns/animal-hospital.md): Check in animal patients, test each one three ways, and shut out the ones that are not really animals, while the hospital fills with hazards. It was the anomaly-spotting hit of ...
- [Anime Vanguards](teardowns/anime-vanguards.md): You summon units from hourly banners at 50 gems a pull and send them through tower defense stages, raids and dungeons. It mattered because its wiki publishes every number of the ...
- [BedWars](teardowns/bedwars.md): Teams collect iron from a generator, buy blocks and weapons, guard their bed and break everyone else's. Once your bed is gone, your next death is final. It peaked at 334,747 ...
- [Bee Swarm Simulator](teardowns/bee-swarm-simulator.md): Your bees gather pollen, your hive turns it into honey, honey buys more bees: a gather-and-convert simulator that still holds about 49,000 players 8.7 years after it was made.
- [Blox Fruits](teardowns/blox-fruits.md): You take quests, level up across three seas and hunt for fruits that give powers. It is the template for the anime grind RPG and has held hundreds of thousands of players since ...
- [Blue Lock: Rivals](teardowns/blue-lock-rivals.md): 5v5 anime soccer where each player's moves come from a style rolled on a spin. It reached 1,097,082 players in March 2025, the biggest peak of any Roblox sports game on the sports ...
- [Brookhaven RP](teardowns/brookhaven.md): A town where the house, the car and the job are free from the first second, and players make up the story; it is the biggest roleplay game on Roblox.
- [Build a Boat for Treasure](teardowns/build-a-boat-for-treasure.md): Build a boat from blocks, launch it down a river of stages, and earn gold for every stage it survives. It shows how to wrap a free building toy in one clear goal, and it has done ...
- [Dead Rails](teardowns/dead-rails.md): Up to four players drive a train 80 km through a zombie-filled West, feeding it anything that burns; it peaked at about 1.5 million players and made fuel the clock of a journey ...
- [Doors](teardowns/doors.md): Open 100 numbered doors in a haunted hotel with up to three friends, and answer each monster with the one move that beats it. It set the template for one tell, one counter and one ...
- [Dress to Impress](teardowns/dress-to-impress.md): Up to 13 players get a theme, dress for 6 minutes, walk a runway one at a time and rate each other from 1 to 5 stars. It made the timed fashion contest one of Roblox's largest ...
- [Epic Minigames](teardowns/epic-minigames.md): Twelve players play a random playlist of about 141 small games, one after another; it has run since 2015 and sells control over the playlist rather than power.
- [Fisch](teardowns/fisch.md): You cast, win an 8-second reeling minigame, and fill a bestiary of 1,527 fish across 153 locations; it mattered because it set the template that Fish It!, The Forge and ...
- [Forsaken](teardowns/forsaken.md): One killer hunts the other players of a 9-player server for a 4-minute round while they repair generators. It is the live benchmark for one-killer-versus-many horror on Roblox, ...
- [Grow a Garden](teardowns/grow-a-garden.md): Buy seeds when the shop restocks, plant, harvest, sell, and show off lucky crops. It set Roblox's concurrent-player record twice in 2025 and is the reference for grow-and-harvest.
- [Jailbreak](teardowns/jailbreak.md): Escape prison, rob banks and stores, and outrun the police, or play the police and cash in criminals' bounties. It is the longest-running open-world cops-and-robbers game on ...
- [Murder Mystery 2](teardowns/murder-mystery-2.md): One murderer, one sheriff and up to ten innocents play a 3-minute round of hide, hunt and guess; a trading economy of cosmetic knives and guns has kept a 2014 game above 100,000 ...
- [Pet Simulator 99](teardowns/pet-simulator-99.md): Hatch pets, break things with them, buy the next area: the longest priced pet ladder on Roblox with public numbers, still in the top 10 four years after launch.
- [RIVALS](teardowns/rivals.md): Short gun duels, first to 5 rounds, queued from pads on a shared lobby floor. It is the only Roblox shooter at scale in 2026.
- [Sol's RNG](teardowns/sols-rng.md): You press one button every 3.2 seconds and get an aura labelled "1 in N"; it matters because it is three years old, still has about 40,000 players, and does it with one button and ...
- [Steal a Brainrot](teardowns/steal-a-brainrot.md): Buy meme characters off a shared carpet, earn from them at a base, lock it, and steal from the neighbours. The first Roblox game past 25 million concurrent players, and the ...
- [Steal An Egg](teardowns/steal-an-egg.md): Train Speed on a treadmill, run into a farther biome, grab an egg and get it home before the guardian or another player knocks you down. The biggest slop hit of 2026 and the ...
- [The Strongest Battlegrounds](teardowns/the-strongest-battlegrounds.md): You pick a hero and fight 14 strangers in one free-for-all arena with no levels to grind. It set the template that most Roblox battlegrounds games copy, down to the pass prices.
- [Throw Food For Animals](teardowns/throw-food-for-animals.md): Train Throw Power, throw food from a launch strip into farther areas, and the animal it attracts goes to your pen and earns. The newest giant of the plus-one family, at 2.47M ...
- [Tower Defense Simulator](teardowns/tower-defense-simulator.md): You place and upgrade towers against 20 to 50 waves with up to three friends, and unlock new towers with coins and levels. It mattered because it set its all-time peak more than ...
- [Tower of Hell](teardowns/tower-of-hell.md): Climb a randomly built tower with no checkpoints before the clock runs out; it is the obby that has held a large audience the longest, with 29.5B visits in eight years.

## Kit

- [Design audit](kit/design-audit.md): A pass/fail and scored review for a Roblox game design. Use it on a design document before building, on a grey-box prototype, or on a live game. It takes about an hour by hand and ...
- [The nothing detector](kit/nothing-detector.md): Most game-design writing is true and useless. "Make the core loop engaging." "Reward the player early." "Add social features." Nobody can build from these sentences and nobody can ...
- [Prompts](kit/prompts.md): Prompts to paste into an AI assistant that has this repository available (cloned into the project, installed as a skill, or attached as files). Each one points the assistant at ...

## Templates

- [Template: core loop table](kit/templates/core-loop-table.md): One row per step of the loop the player repeats most. Time each step with a stopwatch in the running game. Before there is a game, write the time you intend, then measure it as ...
- [Template: economy sheet](kit/templates/economy-sheet.md): Fill this before building any shop, ladder or rebirth. Then copy the numbers into a JSON file and run `python tools/pacing.py` on it. The tool plays the ladder like an ideal ...
- [Template: first-session script](kit/templates/first-session-script.md): Write what a brand-new player does, sees and hears, second by second, from the moment they have control until minute 15. The script is the design of the first session. If a line ...
- [Template: genre playbook](kit/templates/genre-playbook.md): one sentence in a child's words. Example: "I own cool stuff and nobody can take it. I take theirs."
- [Template: one-page design](kit/templates/one-page-design.md): Fill this before building anything. Every blank needs a real answer. "To be decided" is not an answer; if you cannot fill a line, that line is the work to do next.
- [Template: teardown](kit/templates/teardown.md): One sentence: what you do in it and why it mattered.
- [Template: update plan](kit/templates/update-plan.md): One table row per update. An update without a row is a guess nobody will check.

## Data and research

- [Roblox top-charts snapshot (2026-11-25)](data/README.md): A first-hand, dated dataset of what the experiences on Roblox's public charts are, what they charge and what they track
- [Roblox top charts: snapshot analysis (2026-11-25)](data/ANALYSIS.md): Generated by `tools/analyze.py` from `data/*.csv` (written by `tools/snapshot.py`). "Top N" means the N distinct experiences with the most concurrent players (`playing` from ...
- [How this was researched](research/README.md): This page says what the handbook rests on, how it was put together, and where it is weak. Read it before trusting a number more than it deserves.
